title: Map conversation notes into existing E/I and triage architecture
description: Assess the operator-provided conversation_notes.md against MAP current architecture. Separate existing capabilities from genuine gaps, propose bounded experiments for task fingerprints, workstream digests, explainable wait and incident records, and improved E/I retrieval, and explicitly defer duplicate agents, autonomous authority expansion, and external GitHub integration pending evidence and operator decisions.
acceptance_criteria: The intake maps each major proposal to an existing MAP mechanism, a genuine gap, or a deferred idea without creating a duplicate source of truth.
The intake separates adopt-now principles, extensions to existing systems, bounded experiments, and deferred or rejected architecture.
The plan defines measurable experiments for task fingerprints, workstream digests, E/I recall, and explainable waits/incidents while preserving proposal-only authority.
GitHub and external references are treated as optional unverified inputs and no external write or integration is authorized.
